latest_release.name: V4.9.0 Barioth 🐯
latest_release.body:
MiaoYan V4.9.0 Barioth 🐯

A native Markdown editor for engineers.

Changelog

  1. Mac: Exported PDFs match the preview: captions, quotes and video posters are laid out properly, an export from dark mode comes out on a light page, headings in TsangerJinKai are no longer blurred, and a diagram still drawing doesn't print its loading line
  2. Mac: Replace moves on to the next match when the new text still matches the search, and Tab on a numbered item from 10 up keeps the caret on its line
  3. Mac: .md files show MiaoYan's document icon in Finder, and quotes in the preview sit tighter
  4. Mac: The MiaoYan menu and the About window link to the iPhone and iPad apps, which open the same iCloud Drive folder so you can keep writing on your phone and tablet
  5. iPhone and iPad: Tick tasks while reading, keep your place going into the editor and back, open Contents from the menu in a note with several headings, and see table columns aligned as the note wrote them
  6. iPhone and iPad: The editor's menu inserts photos, finds in the note, and offers Undo and Redo, Return continues a list, and Return on an empty item ends it
  7. iPhone and iPad: With a keyboard, Command-T toggles a task, Command-] and Command-[ shift lines, Tab indents a list item, and items nest correctly under a numbered list
  8. iPhone and iPad: Duplicate a note, rename a folder, delete an empty folder, and open a Markdown file from the Files app or a share sheet by choosing MiaoYan
  9. iPhone and iPad: Search matches every word and puts title matches first, a new note you left half written is still there next time, and when the library can't be read the list keeps what it showed and offers Try Again
  10. iPhone and iPad: Empty Trash deletes only the notes its list shows, and when the note you are typing in is renamed, moved or deleted on another device, what you typed is saved as a note of its own

更新日志

  1. Mac：导出的 PDF 和预览保持一致，图片说明、引用和视频封面排版正常，深色模式下导出也是浅色页面，仓耳今楷的标题不再发糊，图表还没画完时不会把加载提示印进去
  2. Mac：查找替换在新内容仍然匹配搜索词时会接着替换下一处，在 10 以上的有序列表项按 Tab，光标留在原来那一行
  3. Mac：访达里的 .md 文件显示妙言的文档图标，预览里的引用排得更紧凑
  4. Mac：妙言菜单和关于窗口里可以找到 iPhone 和 iPad 版，同一个 iCloud 云盘文件夹，在手机和平板上接着写
  5. iPhone 和 iPad：阅读时可以直接勾选任务，从阅读进入编辑、写完回到阅读都停在原来的位置，标题多的笔记可以在菜单里打开目录，表格按笔记里写的方式对齐
  6. iPhone 和 iPad：编辑时菜单里可以插入照片、在笔记里查找、撤销和重做，回车会接着列表往下写，在空的列表项上再按一次回车结束列表
  7. iPhone 和 iPad：接上键盘后 Command-T 切换任务，Command-] 和 Command-[ 缩进整行，Tab 缩进列表项，有序列表下面也能正确嵌套
  8. iPhone 和 iPad：笔记可以复制一份，文件夹可以重命名，空文件夹可以删除，在文件 App 或分享菜单里选妙言就能打开 Markdown 文件
  9. iPhone 和 iPad：搜索按词匹配，标题里有的排在前面，新建笔记写到一半离开，下次新建时草稿还在，笔记库读不出来时列表保留原来的内容并可以重试
  10. iPhone 和 iPad：清空废纸篓只删除列表里看得到的笔记，正在写的笔记在别的设备上被改名、移走或删除时，刚写的内容会另存成一篇

MiaoYan for iPhone and iPad is on the App Store, one purchase covers them and the Mac, and they open the same iCloud Drive folder.

妙言的 iPhone 和 iPad 版在 App Store 上，和 Mac 一次购买通用，打开同一个 iCloud 云盘笔记文件夹，在手机和平板上也能接着写。

If you find MiaoYan useful, please consider giving it a star and recommending it to your friends.

> https://github.com/tw93/MiaoYan

detail.readme:
MiaoYan

A native Mac app for local Markdown notes

MiaoYan is 妙言 in Chinese, words beyond words.

English · 中文 · 繁體 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Deutsch · Français

## Features - **Local-first**: Notes are Markdown files in a folder you choose, with no data collection, and iCloud Drive or Nutstore can sync them across devices - **Focused**: Folders, notes, and editor in three columns, with dark mode and no plugin system to maintain - **Native**: Built with Swift 6, lighter than web wrappers, with 60fps scroll sync in split preview - **Capable**: Wikilinks, LaTeX, Mermaid, version history, auto-formatting, and PPT presentations built in - **Portable**: The iPhone and iPad apps are on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/miaoyan/id6759252269), one purchase covers them and the Mac, and they open the same iCloud Drive folder, so you can keep writing on your phone and tablet ## Installation 1. **App Store** (recommended, one purchase for iPhone, iPad and Mac, automatic updates): 2. **Homebrew**: ```bash brew install --cask miaoyan ``` 3. **GitHub Releases**: download the latest DMG from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/tw93/MiaoYan/releases/latest) (macOS 12.0+) Homebrew and GitHub Releases install the same free, open-source Mac app, which keeps being developed. If you only write on a Mac, the open-source version is enough; to keep writing on iPhone and iPad, get the App Store version. ## Sync with Nutstore or Other Cloud Drives MiaoYan does not sign in to WebDAV or cloud-drive accounts and only reads and writes the Markdown folder you choose. After installing, create a `MiaoYan` folder in iCloud Drive, the local folder synced by the Nutstore desktop client, or any other location, then open Preferences (⌘,) and set it as the storage path. iCloud Drive, Nutstore, Dropbox, or another cloud-drive client handles cross-device sync. - **iPhone**: Pick the same cloud-drive folder in the system Files app, and if a provider does not offer a writable folder there, use iCloud Drive or make the folder available offline in that provider app first - **Folder check**: MiaoYan verifies read and write access before switching folders and keeps the current storage path if the folder is unavailable, without reporting the problem as a MiaoYan sync failure ## CLI ```bash # Install curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/MiaoYan/main/scripts/install.sh | bash # Usage miao open # Open note or folder miao new [text] # Create new note miao search <query> # Search notes in terminal miao list [folder] # List top-level folders, or the Markdown files in a folder miao cat <title|path> # Print note content miao update # Update CLI ``` ## Split Editor & Preview Mode Edit and preview sit side by side. Press `⌘\` to toggle split mode, or open Preferences, go to Editor, and set Default Mode to Split. Why not WYSIWYG like Typora? Pure Markdown editing is the whole point. Native WYSIWYG in Swift is heavy and fragile; split mode keeps writing focused while giving you instant, synchronized visual feedback. <img src="https://miaoyan.app/assets/shots/en-split-2400.webp" width="100%" alt="Split Editor & Preview Mode" /> ## Documentation - [Introduction to MiaoYan](Resources/Initial/Introduction%20to%20MiaoYan.md) - Usage guide and keyboard shortcuts - [Markdown Syntax Guide](Resources/Initial/MiaoYan%20Markdown%20Syntax%20Guide.md) - Syntax reference with math and diagrams - [PPT Presentation Mode](Resources/Initial/MiaoYan%20PPT.md) - Guide to creating presentations with `---` slide separators - [MiaoYan Agent Skill](skills/miaoyan) - Teach your agent MiaoYan syntax, attachments, PPT patterns, and CLI workflows Install the official skill with `npx skills add tw93/MiaoYan/skills/miaoyan -g`. ## Support - The most direct way to support me is getting [Mole for Mac](https://mole.fit), my paid Mac cleanup app - If MiaoYan helped you, give it a star, [share it](https://x.com/intent/tweet?url=https://github.com/tw93/MiaoYan&text=MiaoYan%20-%20A%20native%20Mac%20app%20for%20local%20Markdown%20notes), or open an issue or PR - I have two cats, TangYuan and Coke. If MiaoYan brings you joy, you can feed them <a href="https://cats.tw93.fun?name=MiaoYan" target="_blank">canned food 🥩</a> These lovely people already did 🐱 <a href="https://cats.tw93.fun?name=MiaoYan"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/sponsors/main/assets/sponsors.svg" width="1000" loading="lazy" /></a> ## Acknowledgments - [glushchenko/fsnotes](https://github.com/glushchenko/fsnotes) - Initial project structure reference - [stackotter/swift-cmark-gfm](https://github.com/stackotter/swift-cmark-gfm) - Swift Markdown parser - [simonbs/Prettier](https://github.com/simonbs/Prettier) - Markdown formatting utilities - [raspu/Highlightr](https://github.com/raspu/Highlightr) - Syntax highlighting - [hakimel/reveal.js](https://github.com/hakimel/reveal.js) - PPT presentation framework ## License MIT License
detail.readme_zh:
妙言

轻灵的 Markdown 笔记本伴你写出妙言

English · 中文 · 繁體 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Deutsch · Français

## 特点 - **纯本地**：笔记就是你选定文件夹里的 Markdown 文件，不收集数据，要跨设备就交给 iCloud 云盘或坚果云同步 - **专注**：文件夹、笔记列表和编辑器分成三栏，带深色模式，不用维护插件 - **原生**：Swift 6 开发，比网页套壳更轻，分栏预览支持 60fps 双向滚动同步 - **称手**：双链、LaTeX 公式、Mermaid 图表、版本历史、自动排版和 PPT 演示都内置 - **随身**：iPhone 和 iPad 版在 [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/miaoyan/id6759252269) 上，和 Mac 一次购买通用，打开同一个 iCloud 云盘笔记文件夹，在手机和平板上也能接着写 ## 安装使用 1. **App Store**（推荐，一次购买 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 都能用，自动更新）： 2. **Homebrew**： ```bash brew install --cask miaoyan ``` 3. **GitHub Releases**：从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/tw93/MiaoYan/releases/latest) 下载最新 DMG（macOS 12.0+） Homebrew 与 GitHub Releases 分发的是同一个开源免费的 Mac 版本，会一直更新，只在 Mac 上写的话开源版就够了，想在手机和平板上接着写，就选 App Store 版。 ## 用坚果云或其他云盘同步妙言 妙言不会登录 WebDAV 或网盘账号，只读写你指定的 Markdown 文件夹，跨设备同步交给 iCloud 云盘、坚果云、Dropbox 等云盘客户端。安装后在 iCloud 云盘、坚果云桌面客户端的同步目录或其他位置创建 `MiaoYan` 文件夹，打开设置（⌘,）把存储位置指向它，就可以开始写了。 - **iPhone**：在系统“文件”App 中选择同一个云盘文件夹，云盘 App 没有提供可写文件夹的话，就用 iCloud 云盘，或先在云盘 App 里把这个文件夹设为离线可用再选 - **目录检查**：妙言会在切换目录前确认文件夹可读写，不可用时保留原路径，也不会把问题误报成妙言自己的云同步失败 ## 命令行工具 ```bash # 安装 curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tw93/MiaoYan/main/scripts/install.sh | bash # 使用 miao open <标题|路径> # 打开笔记或文件夹 miao new <标题> [内容] # 创建新笔记 miao search <关键词> # 在终端搜索笔记 miao list [目录] # 列出一级目录，或列出指定目录下的 Markdown miao cat <标题|路径> # 输出笔记内容 miao update # 更新 CLI ``` ## 分栏编辑预览模式 编辑区和预览区并排显示，按 `⌘\` 切换分栏模式，或在设置的编辑器页把默认模式设为分栏。为什么不做 Typora 式所见即所得？我想让你一直看着 Markdown 原文写，用原生 Swift 做所见即所得很重，也难保证稳定，分栏模式能专心写字，旁边就是实时预览。 ## 使用指南 - [介绍妙言](Resources/Initial/介绍妙言.md) - 使用说明和快捷键 - [Markdown 语法指南](Resources/Initial/妙言%20Markdown%20语法指南.md) - 语法演示，含数学公式和图表 - [PPT 演示模式](Resources/Initial/妙言%20PPT.md) - 使用 `---` 分隔幻灯片的演示指南 - [妙言 Agent Skill](skills/miaoyan) - 让 Agent 掌握妙言语法、附件、PPT 与 CLI 使用方式 运行 `npx skills add tw93/MiaoYan/skills/miaoyan -g` 安装官方 Skill。 ## 支持 - 购买我做的 Mac 清理应用 [Mole for Mac](https://mole.fit)，是对我最直接的支持 - 如果你喜欢妙言，欢迎给它一个 Star，推荐给身边喜欢纯文本的朋友，[分享出去](https://x.com/intent/tweet?url=https://github.com/tw93/MiaoYan&text=%E5%A6%99%E8%A8%80%20-%20%E8%BD%BB%E7%81%B5%E7%9A%84%20Markdown%20%E7%AC%94%E8%AE%B0%E6%9C%AC%EF%BC%8C%E4%BC%B4%E4%BD%A0%E5%86%99%E5%87%BA%E5%A6%99%E8%A8%80)，或者提 issue 和 PR - 我有两只猫，汤圆和可乐，如果妙言让你开心，可以请她们吃罐头 🥩 这些可爱的朋友已经投喂过了 🐱 ## 致谢 - [glushchenko/fsnotes](https://github.com/glushchenko/fsnotes) - 项目初始结构参考 - [stackotter/swift-cmark-gfm](https://github.com/stackotter/swift-cmark-gfm) - Swift Markdown 解析器 - [simonbs/Prettier](https://github.com/simonbs/Prettier) - Markdown 格式化工具 - [raspu/Highlightr](https://github.com/raspu/Highlightr) - 语法高亮支持 - [hakimel/reveal.js](https://github.com/hakimel/reveal.js) - PPT 演示框架 ## 协议 MIT License
